reviews.text: Spectacular

I adopted my kitten from the clinic! I found out about it through a recommendation and contacted them on WhatsApp… from the first contact, Dr. Maria Inês was attentive! When I went to pick her up, the receptionist answered all my questions and was so sweet!!!

I've known Dr. Inês for over 20 years. We've built a history together! I adopted several kittens from the clinic, and they were always cared for by Dr. Maria Inês, so she's been with my kittens since adoption until their final moments. Unfortunately, pets don't live as long as we do and leave us too soon. When I needed the doctor's help during difficult and painful times, she always promptly assisted me. One Sunday, my cat Fred, who was about 17 years old at the time and had been experiencing health problems due to his age, reached his limit. We called the doctor, and she opened the clinic to receive us. His time had come… euthanasia was our way of showing our unconditional love one last time… She explained how the procedure would be done, and at that moment I felt confident that I was doing what was best for him. I will always be grateful to Dr. Inês and her team. I know I can ALWAYS count on her! Thank you so much!
I recently went through a very traumatic and difficult time with my dog. Dr. Maria Inês, in addition to being very professional as always, was extremely humane.

Since I first went to this clinic, I've never switched. They have excellent professionals, I love Maria Ines Barauna, she's extremely polite, professional, a true veterinarian, she examines the entire dog during consultations, and she's super up-to-date! I highly recommend VET SP.

I've been a regular at VetSP for many years. Dr. Maria Inês saved my dog ​​from a rare disease, and I'll never forget it! Furthermore, it was through her that I adopted my other dog, now 13 years old, healthy and happy. And she also helped me when a cat appeared at my house and decided to give birth to seven kittens many years ago. In short, she and her team, especially Dr. Carolina and Andrea, are extremely competent and dedicated professionals, and very importantly, they are all very caring with our pets.
Dr. Inês is an excellent veterinarian.

Dr. Maria Inês is an excellent veterinarian; she diagnoses accurately and sensibly. She is the veterinarian for my two dogs, one of whom has diabetes. The tips she gave me for treating diabetes have made our lives much easier.

I discovered Vetsp clinic over 10 years ago while searching Google for a dermatologist. Since then, Dr. Maria Inês has become our trusted veterinarian. We've never left her: our Boo, Mike, Ágatha, and now Bulma are all her patients, receiving vaccinations and care, from routine checkups and skin treatments to surgical procedures. Dr. Maria Inês is extremely competent, attentive, quick-witted, makes accurate diagnoses, is super up-to-date, and is incredibly kind, upbeat, and very, very loving with animals. The clinic is clean, organized, and very well-equipped. I always recommend the clinic, and when I talk to other people who also know Vetsp, I always hear praise!

All the veterinarians are very attentive and humane.

The receptionists too.
Personalized care, with lots of love from the reception to the veterinarians Dr. Maria Inês and Carol.
It's the best vet clinic in São Paulo, Maria Inês and the other professionals deserve congratulations, I highly recommend it.

Osvalda Filomena - that's what my pet/daughter was "baptized," cared for by Dr. Maria Inês and Dr. Carol in the last years of her life. Both treated my baby with great attention and affection. Accurate diagnoses and correct medication prescriptions! In addition to their knowledge and experience, the entire team (including Andrea) also has empathy for the pet owners/parents!

I only have praise to give!

Excellent service!!!
Dr. Maria Inês is sensational and my dog ​​loves her because she truly loves animals!
I've been going there for over 10 years!!!
I wouldn't trade it for any other clinic!
Pets and humans feel good and welcomed in this place!

I have deep admiration for Dr. Maria Inês Barauna, who runs the VET SP Veterinary Clinic, not only for her extreme competence but also for her respect and affection for animals. From the moment they arrive, pet owners are very well received, even during delicate moments with their pets. The veterinary care provided at the clinic is excellent, and I can say this because I have always had animals and have been to many hospitals and clinics. I am a loyal client of VET SP, which inspires complete confidence and peace of mind by providing the best treatment for my beloved pets.

The veterinarians and their assistant are always ready to help and monitor the pet's health development if necessary. Not to mention that they also promote responsible adoption. I recommend the clinic. Malu is a patient.

Seventeen years ago, Dr. Inês Barauna, who was unknown to me at the time, provided emergency care for my Akita, who had ingested toxic material.
She saved her and me along with her.
Since then, our canine family has been cared for at VetSP.
Trust, professionalism, competence, dedication, and friendship are the pillars of this clinic, run by Dr. Inês and supported by Dr. Carol and Andreia.

I have been a VetSP client for many years and all my kittens have been cared for by Dr. Inês, the best doctor I have ever known. All the problems they had were detected and successfully treated, and all my furry friends were adopted from the clinic.
I am very grateful for all the attention and care they receive... from the reception with Andreia, Dr. Carol is also very caring... thank you all.

Professionalism 1000/10! Dr. Maria Inês is a sweetheart! Attentive and caring! An excellent professional! The service, the environment, everything was 1000/10!!! I highly recommend her to pet parents.

I've known Vet SP since 2021. I adopted two kittens from them and I've been very happy. The service and the professionals are excellent. I only take my cat there. Besides the service and the team's expertise, their work caring for rescued kittens and finding homes for them is commendable. This demonstrates their love for animals and the professionalism of the team. That's where true veterinarians stand out. I recommend Vet SP whether you're looking after your furry friend or adopting a kitten. I guarantee it. Your life will never be the same.

Clínica VET SP has a perfect structure and service, with Dr. Maria Inês as the veterinarian, who is an excellent professional, highly qualified, competent, and attentive. She took care of my Pug, who lived for 16 years, and now takes care of my other pet, also a Pug, with great care, attention, and affection.

I highly recommend it!
Clean, cozy, and well-structured place. The best veterinarian my dog ​​has ever had, dedicated and very attentive. I appreciate all the love and care shown for every appointment Nick received.
Excellent location, well-equipped and organized clinic, and the veterinarians were very attentive and caring with my cats. I recommend it.

Words cannot describe my complete satisfaction with the entire clinic. I've been a client for 17 years, consultations, vaccinations, and all clinical aspects are impeccable, they've never made a wrong diagnosis, all treatments have been satisfactory, and there have been many! Dr. Inês is excellent, excellent, excellent ❤️ Dr. Carol is perfect too. I'm so grateful and will always recommend them, and I'll even say more... if anyone doesn't like it, I'll pay for the consultation. Just gratitude.

For pet owners and furry friends, there's nothing better than the courteous and reliable service we receive at VET SP. The dedication and care we receive are priceless! I had a very difficult situation with a wonderful cat, and Dr. Maria Ines' support was fundamental throughout the entire diagnosis, surgery, and follow-up process. Today she cares for a new furry friend – Mylla, who is overjoyed at every visit!

I highly recommend them!!!
Excellent professionals. I recommend them with complete confidence!

Excellent professionals, a clinic with great facilities.

I've been a client for many years.

VET SP is a great clinic. Dr. Maria Ines has been taking care of my Chico (Shih Tzu) for some time now with affection, attention, and competence. It's a place where you and your pet feel welcomed from reception to consultation or treatment.
I appreciate and trust all the work done at VET SP very much.
Chico and I are grateful!
😘

For over 20 years, Dr. Maria Ines Barauna has treated my cats and has always been my favorite vet. Besides being competent, she's a sweetheart and treats all her patients and owners very well. She's also always helping with rescued kittens that are up for adoption.

The service from receptionist Andréa to Dr. Maria Inês is excellent. Whenever I need help, I am promptly attended to. She is always a professional concerned about my little girl's condition. She pays attention to all the details of the exams, leaving nothing unnoticed.
Dr., I thank you for everything you have done and continue to do for my Nina.

I highly recommend Clínica Vet SP.

Care, affection, and love from arrival to departure. A professional and dedicated team, and Dr. Maria Inês makes all the difference with her experience, ethics, and knowledge. I recommend her without hesitation. She has been taking care of my dogs for 14 years! ♥️
Excellent service, Dr. Maria Inês is very competent and saved my little dog. Thank you so much for everything.

A fantastic clinic, from the receptionist and all the staff, and Dr. Maria Inês is sensational.
She has been taking care of my pets for 30 years. So trust, dedication, and lots of love are just a few of the positive points.
Gratitude is an understatement.

Specialized clinic! Excellent professional service!
Offers vaccination, diagnosis, and treatment!
Led by the highly qualified Dr. Maria Inês Baraúna, who works diligently in the veterinary field, also providing spaying/neutering and vaccination services for abandoned kittens and dogs, and promoting responsible adoptions!
We need more professionals like her.
I leave here my gratitude for all the care my last 3 beloved pets received over years of assistance ♥️👏🏻
Stella Maris Rossi

HUMANIZED, UNTIL PAGE 2!

I was told that this unit offered humane treatment, especially in the most critical situations, but that wasn't the case.

Unexpected events and emergencies happen, especially when you work in healthcare (human or animal). My dog ​​was on his last legs, his condition worsened significantly, so I decided to have him euthanized to stop him from suffering. Even though he wasn't a previous patient, the clinic has the capacity and structure for the procedure. THIS PROCEDURE CANNOT BE SCHEDULED!!!

The doctor hadn't arrived yet, so I was told to wait for a phone call to proceed with my request. However, this was DENIED BY THE DOCTOR because "she had a personal commitment and couldn't perform the procedure," which led me to look for other options.

This is my account: a terrible veterinary professional, however, they have an impeccable receptionist/secretary, Andréa, who treated me wonderfully.

If you want to end your pet's suffering, you have to make an appointment at this place, because that's when the "professional" is available. If I could, I'd give it 0 stars.

IF YOU DON'T WANT TO DO THE JOB, DON'T GET SERVICE ON WEEKENDS!!

I visited the clinic today for the first time, taking Pitoco for his annual vaccinations with Dr. Maria Inês. It was a unique experience! She was super attentive and examined him thoroughly! He's 1 year and 5 months old, a very playful Shih Tzu, and he received excellent care! We felt welcomed and left happy! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT! Thank you so much for the excellent service! From reception to departure... I recommend it!!
Excellent service and fair price. Great professionals!

My Shih Tzu, Isabela, is a patient of Dr. Maria Inês Barauna, owner and veterinarian at VET SP for 13 years. She is super competent, caring, and punctual – that's how her service is.
I highly recommend her.

I highly recommend it.
Despite being quite wary, my cat Luke felt comfortable with the vet.

And as you can see in the photos, the clinic has very dedicated receptionists who kept my husband company during Luke's appointment 💖
Excellent service. Very beautiful and comfortable space.

Dr. Maria Inês is incredible, an excellent professional, very transparent, always up-to-date and very attentive. 💕 The consultations are always a lesson and she has a very special way of handling felines, with all the patience in the world. Furthermore, I adopted one of my kittens from her clinic thanks to her wonderful work rescuing abandoned kittens. I recommend her without hesitation! 🐈‍⬛
Best veterinary clinic

Dr. Inês is one of the best veterinarians I have ever known, having cared for my pets (dogs and cats) with medical excellence and a personal treatment of pet owners that leaves everyone absolutely calm and satisfied! May God bless her and continue to heal our beloved pets!
I adopted my kitten from this clinic. Dr. Inês is very attentive and super professional. All the procedures with my cat are done at this clinic. I highly recommend them, they are all top-notch.
